name: Metakinetic Mastery
description:
**Subclass Feature**

Discipline 2: Whenever you use the Knockback maneuver, the forced movement distance gains a +2 bonus. Discipline 4: The first time in a combat round that you take damage or are force moved, you gain 1 surge, even if you resist the effect. Discipline 6: You gain an edge on the Grab and Knockback maneuvers.
